## What We Do

### Building a Better World with Applied Artificial Intelligence

AI Capital’s mission is to execute on an investment strategy that delivers favorable and meaningful results to our Limited Partners.

We invest in AI-enabled business software companies that facilitate efficiencies and foster resilience in the supply and delivery of critical goods and services.

AI Capital brings decades of expertise in designing, building, and implementing artificial intelligence systems in both startups and Fortune 500 companies. We understand the various AI techniques and systems as scientists as well as how to apply them to solve myriad business challenges.

AI Capital team members know the process and have made the corporate decisions for software purchases that include navigating policies, procedures, and approvals required for adoption of software into corporate technology architectures.

Our advisory team’s unique experience in the procurement, organization, valuation, and monetization of web scale data is a key differentiator in our approach.

## Who We Are

### Expertise in Technology _and_ Investments

AI Capital is a venture capital firm based in Denver with operations in Baltimore, Boston, Las Vegas, and Vail. We invest in early growth-stage, enterprise, applied artificial intelligence software companies around the world that focus on the digitization of society and business.

With the backdrop of technology and corporate executive expertise, our team has dozens of years of investment experience in executive roles and as allocators of capital in both private and public markets.

Together, we bring a powerful combination to properly diligence a company’s technological claims _and_ assess its business viability.

Furthermore, we are also entrepreneurs and operators who understand the determination, grit, and sheer will required to establish, grow, and profitably exit a business.

## How We’ve Invested

- In ancient Greek city-states, the agorá was a central public space for business, athletic, artistic, social, spiritual, and political life in the city. A marketplace of sorts.



The Agorai “marketplace” enables companies to unlock the value of intangible assets such as data, IP, and brands, allowing businesses to better monetize their data assets. Agorai and its business units unlock the monetary value of data by applying a unique combination of technology, industry knowledge, financial engineering expertise, and capital.

- Caladrius Ventures (“Caladrius”) identifies, funds and develops high impact, novel therapeutics programs from today’s most innovative platform therapeutics businesses.



Through its deep network and best-in- class assessment protocols of drug IP opportunities, Caladrius is optimally positioned to capitalize on the current drug development market environment.

- DataFi enables firms to finance data assets the client-company owns. DataFi has worked with businesses such as commercial airlines, professional sports teams, and insurance companies to help them unlock the value of their data so that those assets can be monetized.

- Link3D is an additive workflow and digital manufacturing software company that supports customers in major manufacturing industries. Additive Manufacturing (AM), sometimes referred to as 3D printing, requires multiple steps from design to producing the final product. Customers included Lockheed Martin, Baker Hughes, and Google..



Link3D was [acquired by Materialise](https://investors.materialise.com/news-releases/news-release-details/materialise-exercises-option-acquire-link3d) (NASDAQ: MTLS).

- Luminoso is an industry leader in the application of Natural Language Understanding (NLU) technology, providing an end-to-end solution for processing unstructured data such as reviews, surveys, text, chat, voice, and support tickets to deliver clear insights within minutes.

- What Google did for search, MIIT-Born Netra does for video. Using artificial intelligence that provides video comprehension and contextualization for live streams and stored video in milliseconds, Netra’s customers utilize the technology for brand safety and optimal advertising placement.



Netra was acquired by Claravine.

- Noetic Machines’ technology’s ability to adapt to new environments and continuously learn, paired with its low energy consumption, make it possible to deploy Adaptive AI onto a silicon chip to be used on the edge without internet connectivity. The technology behind Noetic Machines has been on a twenty-year journey and is now being commercially deployed.

- Syndesis Health (“Syndesis”) accelerates research and innovation for healthcare and life sciences companies by gathering clinical and genomic data from largely untapped, global sources. Access to high quality data from hospital networks serving global populations is critical to achieving more comprehensive, valuable clinical insights and overcoming the historical inequity in healthcare treatment and drug development research. We purpose built Syndesis with these goals in mind and now count more than 35m patient medical records across 16 countries.

- Xeomics provides turnkey solutions in genomic testing and sequencing at an individual, organizational, and national level, to unpack deep genetic insights aimed at improving patient lives and global health equity.

- XRHealth is a pioneering platform and clinic at the intersection of healthcare and Extended Reality (AR/VR) technology. It offers a suite of VR therapeutic applications designed to enhance patient care through immersive experiences. These tools are used for a variety of health conditions, including mental health, physical rehabilitation, and cognitive improvement, providing both patients and providers with advanced options for treatment and therapy.
